properties.description: Cobalt sulfide on Fluorine-doped Tin Oxide substrate

nodes.name: Potentiodynamic electrodeposition of Co-S
nodes.procedure: Potentiodynamic electrodeposition via consecutive linear scanning between -1.2 and 0.2 V vs Ag/AgCl on FTO substrate.
nodes.source_text: Our group used this method to successfully synthesize porous cobalt-sulfide films (Co-S) on fluorinedoped tin oxide (FTO) by consecutive linear scanning between −1.2 and 0.2 V vs Ag/AgCl.

nodes.name: Potentiodynamic electrodeposition of Ni-S
nodes.procedure: Potentiodynamic electrodeposition to synthesize porous amorphous nickel-sulfide films with tunable thickness.
nodes.source_text: Such a facile potentiodynamic electrodeposition is also effective to synthesize porous amorphous nickel-sulfide films (Ni-S) with tunable thickness.

nodes.name: Potentiodynamic electrodeposition of Co-P
nodes.procedure: Potentiodynamic electrodeposition of cobalt-phosphorus-derived films on Cu foil.
nodes.source_text: Similarly, cobalt-phosphorus-derived films (Co-P) on Cu foil (CF) can be obtained as well.

nodes.name: Galvanostatic electrodeposition of hp-Ni
nodes.procedure: Galvanostatic electrodeposition on commercial Ni foam at -3.0 A cm⁻² for 500 s from Ni²⁺ precursor solution.
nodes.source_text: We used this strategy to prepare a hierarchically porous Ni framework on commercial Ni foam (hp-Ni) at −3.0 A cm⁻² for 500 s.

nodes.name: Galvanostatic electrodeposition of Cu₃Ag₇/CF
nodes.procedure: Galvanostatic electrodeposition at -3.0 A cm⁻² for only 30 s from an aqueous electrolyte containing both Ag⁺ and Cu²⁺ species on copper foam.
nodes.source_text: we synthesized porous pine needle-like Cu₃Ag₇ on copper foam (Cu₃Ag₇/CF) at −3.0 A cm⁻² for only 30 s from an aqueous electrolyte containing both Ag⁺ and Cu²⁺ species.

nodes.name: Galvanostatic electrodeposition + phosphorization
nodes.procedure: Galvanostatic electrodeposition of hp-Ni followed by phosphorization to form 3D hierarchically porous urchin-like Ni₂P superstructures on NF.
nodes.source_text: we explored the synthesis of 3D hierarchically porous urchin-like Ni₂P superstructures on NF (Ni₂P/Ni/NF) via galvanostatic electrodeposition of hp-Ni followed by phosphorization.

nodes.name: Electroshock electrodeposition of NiCoCuMoW
nodes.procedure: Electroshock synthesis by applying pulsed potential of -6 V with on time of 0.2 s and off time of 0.8 s for 400 cycles.
nodes.source_text: We synthesized a porous NiCoCuMoW multielement alloy (MEA) by electroshock in which pulsed potential of −6 V was applied with an on time of 0.2 s and an off time of 0.8 s for 400 cycles.

nodes.name: Nitrogen modification of hp-Ni
nodes.procedure: Galvanostatic electrodeposition of hp-Ni followed by low-temperature ammonium carbonate treatment to obtain surface nitrogen modified porous metals (N-Ni).
nodes.source_text: we obtained diverse surface nitrogen modified porous metals (e.g., N-Ni, N-Fe, N-Co, N-Cu, and N-NiCo alloy) by galvanostatic electrodeposition and subsequent low-temperature ammonium carbonate treatment.

nodes.name: Partial nitridation of hp-Ni
nodes.procedure: High-temperature annealing of hp-Ni in ammonia to create Ni₃N/Ni interfaces.
nodes.source_text: partially nitriding the hp-Ni through high-temperature annealing in ammonia creates the interfaces between Ni and Ni₃N

nodes.name: Partial nitridation of Co nanoparticles
nodes.procedure: Partial nitridation of cobalt nanoparticles on cobalt foam or carbon paper.
nodes.source_text: A similar structure could be obtained via partial nitridation of cobalt nanoparticles on cobalt foam (Co₂N/Co/CF) or carbon paper (Co₂N/Co/CP).
